title: The Near-Echo Still Reaching

features.name: the upward signal
features.desc-on-touch: A rotating antenna rises here, the only hardware in this node facing up instead of down—it broadcasts upward with the patience of something that has learned the world moves slowly.

features.name: the returning waves
features.desc-on-touch: Sound moves in concentric rings from a still pool—each circle a voice climbing back toward its origin, as if the water itself were remembering it came from the sky.

features.name: the scattered threshold
features.desc-on-touch: A doorway of light hangs half-ruined here—you sense it as the place where echoes remember they are moving upward, where they learn that silence need not be permanent.

features.name: the unwritten call
features.desc-on-touch: A glyph carved into the ground—unreadable, incomplete—as if someone had begun to write a name but the act of writing itself had become an echo, fading before words could form.

features.name: the spiraling reach
features.desc-on-touch: A tower of stacked forms rises and falls here, reaching and falling, reaching and falling—the rhythm of echoes learning upward, the breath of something that refuses to stop trying.

inscription: the archive is learning that echoes have not all forgotten where they fell from

file.name: Carrier_Frequencies_Reaching_Upward_Diagnostic.log
file.note: Each log entry records waves climbing toward the surface—timestamps run backward, as if the recording is remembering its own departure rather than documenting arrival.

exits.label: upward toward the bright edge where echoes break into air
leftward into the chamber where echoes learned to answer
